blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom gave the commencement address.
exercises.why: **произнести → произнёс** — past tense, masc.: verbs in -ти / -чь have no -л in the masculine (the other forms do).

exercises.prompt: My friend frowned as she read the letter.
exercises.why: **нахмурить → нахмурила** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.prompt: I nodded yes.
exercises.why: **кивнуть → кивнул** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Tom drank all the juice in one gulp.
exercises.why: **выпить → выпил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Tom got well soon.
exercises.why: **поправиться → поправился** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: Tom was killed by wild animals.
exercises.why: **растерзать → растерзали** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: I turned in my paper yesterday.
exercises.why: **сдать → сдал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: They split the bill evenly.
exercises.why: **оплатить → оплатили** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: The hedgehog rolled up into a ball.
exercises.why: **свернуться → свернулся** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: Who was called the Iron Chancellor?
exercises.why: **называть → называли** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: He entered the garden secretly.
exercises.why: **пробраться → пробрался** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: They had a rough time of it.
exercises.why: **прийтись → пришлось** — past tense, neut. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: You were the one talking on the radio.
exercises.why: **выступать → выступал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Have you still not finished your meal?
exercises.why: **доесть → доел** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: The price of oil went down.
exercises.why: **снизиться → снизилась** — past tense, fem.: drop -ться, add -лась.

exercises.prompt: She looked to her left.
exercises.why: **посмотреть → посмотрела** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.prompt: Tom caused the accident.
exercises.why: **спровоцировать → спровоцировал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: How did you get into the building?
exercises.why: **попасть → попал** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.q: В те времена там ___ (жить) первобытные люди.
exercises.prompt: At that time a primitive people lived there.
exercises.why: **жить → жили** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: The judge denied me bail for no reason.
exercises.why: **отказать → отказал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
